name: Hardware and Operating System Foundations
description: Four-course specialization developed by the Illinois Institute of Technology (Illinois Tech) on Coursera. Provides a comprehensive foundation in the features, management, and security of both Windows and Linux operating systems. Covers command-line tools (CLI, PowerShell, Bash), filesystem hierarchy, user access control, process management, registry configuration, threat hardening, and system security protocols.

criteria.narrative: Completed all four courses in the Hardware and Operating System Foundations Specialization developed by the Illinois Institute of Technology on Coursera: (1) Hardware and Operating System Foundations I, (2) Hardware and Operating System Foundations II, (3) Hardware and Operating System Foundations III, and (4) Hardware and OS Foundations Capstone.
